untertitel_admin: Folders that are reachable on the network via SMB – for Mac, Windows, Linux and Time Machine.
untertitel_nutzer: You see the shares you have access to. “Connect” gives you the path for your device.
keine_admin: No share yet. Create the first one with “New share”.
keine_nutzer: No share has been made available to you yet. Ask the admin.
kopieren_fehl: Copying failed – please select the text and copy it yourself.
symbol_gaeste: Guests can access without signing in
symbol_papierkorb: Deleted files go to the recycle bin
verbindung_adresse_erklaerung: Enter this address in your device's file manager – works at home and via VPN. Sign in with your FAH-NAS name and password.
verbindung_fehl: The connection info could not be loaded.
name: Name
name_erklaerung: Lowercase, 1–32 characters from a–z, 0–9, - and _. Becomes the folder name and network address (smb://nas/name). Cannot be changed later.
name_fehler: Share name: lowercase, 1–32 characters from a-z, 0-9, - and _
beschreibung_erklaerung: Short text shown in the list and as a comment on the network – without quotation marks (") or line breaks.
beschreibung_fehler: The description must not contain quotation marks (") or line breaks.
rechte_erklaerung: Who may do what? Write includes read. Groups (@) apply to all members. Admins always have full access to management, but only the rights set here for the files. Without rights and guest access, the share is reachable by nobody.
rechte_keine_nutzer: There are no other users or groups yet. Create them under “Users”.
rechte_laden_fehl: Users and groups could not be loaded – the rights table stays empty.
gaeste_erklaerung: Anyone on the network can read AND write without a password. Only sensible for non-critical things like media on the home network.
gaeste_warnung: Warning: with guest access, every device on your network can read and change these files – without signing in.
papierkorb_erklaerung: Deleted files first go to the share's recycle bin and can be restored in the file manager.
timemachine_erklaerung: The share is offered to Macs as a Time Machine destination. The recycle bin is turned off (Time Machine cleans up old versions itself). Set a quota below, or Time Machine will fill the whole disk.
timemachine_hinweis: Time Machine is told the quota as the size. Without a quota (0), the backup grows until the disk is full.
kontingent_erklaerung: Maximum space the share may use, in GiB (1 GiB = 1024 × 1024 × 1024 bytes – the same as the figures under Files and Dashboard). 0 = unlimited (removes an existing quota). For Time Machine, this is also the size reported to the Mac.
kontingent_fehler: Please enter a whole number of 0 or more.
versteckt_erklaerung: The share does not appear in the network overview. You can still connect via its address.
plan_erklaerung: Set up regular snapshots of this share and their retention under “Snapshots”.
loeschen_erklaerung: The share disappears from the network. What should happen to the files?
loeschen_behalten_erklaerung: The folder is moved to /data/backup/geloescht and can be retrieved from there later.
loeschen_loeschen_erklaerung: All files and snapshots of this share will be deleted irreversibly.
loeschen_tippen: Type the share name to confirm
loeschen_tippen_erklaerung: Protection against accidents: the button is enabled only once “{name}” is entered here.
symbol_verbund: Storage pool of several disks – managed under Drives → Storage pools.
krypt_erklaerung: The data is stored only in encrypted form. After a restart the share is locked until you unlock it with the password.
krypt_warnung: Without the password the data is lost – for you too. Please keep it safe (e.g. in a password manager).
krypt_passwort_erklaerung: At least 8 characters, a long sentence is better.
krypt_merken_erklaerung: Stores the key on the NAS. Convenient, but then it only protects if the disk alone is stolen.
krypt_zu_kurz: The password needs at least 8 characters.
krypt_sperren_frage: Lock “{name}”? Close open files on computers and in apps first.
ort_neu: Will be created on the data disk ({modell}) at {pfad}.
ort_neu_ohne_modell: Will be created on the data disk at {pfad}.
ordnerrechte_info: Folders with their own permissions. Set them in Files via ⋯ → Folder permissions.
symbol_import: Folder “{ordner}” of a taken-over volume (other NAS)
rechte_uebertragen_titel: Sets the share's permissions on all existing files and folders – otherwise they only apply to new ones.
rechte_uebertragen_frage: Apply the permissions of “{name}” to all existing files? Contents stay unchanged; folder permissions remain. This takes a while with many files.
